classification.difficultyReason: Infer two length constraints from repeated rectangles and find dimensions satisfying both by guess and check.

content.prompt: Determine the length and width of each of the small identical rectangles.

spec.description: Three columns of three vertically stacked pairs of rectangles, with alternating horizontal bridges and individual vertical rectangles in both intervening gaps. Every individual boundary and white gap is retained.
spec.mathematics: For width x and length y, the overall width is 6x+2y=30 and the overall height is 2x+3y=31. No x or y labels appear in the student figure.
spec.answerVisibility: Only overall dimensions 30 cm and 31 cm are visible; no solution dimensions or equations are printed.

answer.short: Length $9\text{ cm}$; width $2\text{ cm}$. Using width $x$ and length $y$, $6x+2y=30$ and $2x+3y=31$; guess and check gives $x=2$, $y=9$.
answer.worked:
Let $x$ cm be the width and $y$ cm be the length of each rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}6x+2y&=30\\2x+3y&=31\end{align*}$$
By guess and check, try $y=9$ and $x=2$.
$$\begin{align*}6(2)+2(9)&=30\\2(2)+3(9)&=31\end{align*}$$
Both dimensions match. Each rectangle has length $9\text{ cm}$ and width $2\text{ cm}$.
